_about: Ukrainian letters in the Oracles message font. A letter's byte value is also its font cell (cell n = 16 bytes at font_offset + 16 * n). Letters that Russian uses keep the cp1251 code the Russian hack uses. The eight Ukrainian-only letters take cp1251 codes that the English text never uses (and the Russian hack uses only for leftover art). The Russian hack uses cp1251 0x98 nowhere, so the Ukrainian є takes 0x98. The glyph images are drawn by a person; the cells start empty (0xFF = blank).

notes.0xB8-0xBB: Button icons (A and B) in the English text. Ukrainian cannot use them, so « » and є at 0xBA are not used.
notes.0xDA, 0xDB, 0xDD: Russian-only letters (Ъ Ы Э) and Ъ ы э in lower case are not in the Ukrainian set.
